description: Address code review feedback: timezone init, username exception wrapping, dead code removal, targeted notification cancellation, and premium coming soon clarity
steps: 1. Fix notification_service.dart: Add timezone detection in initialize() using FlutterTimezone.getLocalTimezone() and tz.setLocalLocation(tz.getLocation(timezoneName)).
2. Fix auth_service.dart: Wrap _validateUsername raw String throws in AppAuthException.
3. Fix settings_screen.dart: Remove dead code path that checks for 'requires-recent-login' and replace with a generic error message.

4. Fix reminder_settings_screen.dart + notification_service.dart: Add individual cancel methods (cancelPushupReminder, cancelFoodLogReminders, cancelWaterReminders) and use targeted cancellation instead of cancelAllReminders in toggle handlers.
5. Fix premium_screen.dart: Add a 'Coming Soon' indicator on the CTA button so users understand the feature is not live yet.
acceptance_criteria: notification_service.dart initialize() calls FlutterTimezone.getLocalTimezone() and tz.setLocalLocation()
_validateUsername throws AppAuthException instead of raw String
notification_service.dart has cancelPushupReminder(), cancelFoodLogReminders(), cancelWaterReminders() methods
reminder_settings_screen.dart uses targeted cancel methods instead of cancelAllReminders()
premium_screen.dart CTA has a visible 'Coming Soon' indicator
verification: Grep for raw String throws in _validateUsername
Grep for 'requires-recent-login' in settings_screen.dart (should not exist)
Grep for cancelAllReminders in reminder_settings_screen.dart (should not exist)
Read premium_screen.dart CTA section for Coming Soon indicator
findings: All 5 critical review items addressed: (1) Added FlutterTimezone.getLocalTimezone() and tz.setLocalLocation() in notification_service.dart initialize() with a try/catch fallback to UTC. (2) _validateUsername now throws AppAuthException instead of raw String. (3) Removed dead 'requires-recent-login' string match from settings_screen.dart _confirmDeleteAccount. (4) Added cancelPushupReminder(), cancelFoodLogReminders(), cancelWaterReminders() to notification_service.dart and updated reminder_settings_screen.dart toggles to use them directly, eliminating the cancel-all-then-reschedule race. (5) Added a visible Coming Soon badge above the CTA button on premium_screen.dart. No Flutter SDK available for build verification - validated via static code review.
